items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: And it became a solo vehicle for you, for Johnny Hodges, for Willie Smith, for Harry Carney and for anybody else?

ctx.x: By different members of the band, different interpretations, different renditions of it.
And it became a solo vehicle for you, for Johnny Hodges, for Willie Smith, for Harry Carney and for anybody else?
Ah, Blanton and well almost everybody that was soloing, made some sort of a record of 'Sophisticated Lady.'
